recognize_zh: 抹片中成群大型異常前骨髓細胞，胞質充滿密集的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，部分胞核呈雙葉或腎形折疊，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）；此視野未見Niemann-Pick泡沫細胞。
features: Clusters of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm heavily packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules, partly obscuring the nucleus
Nuclei reniform, folded or bilobed with fine chromatin
Pale blue agranular cytoplasmic rim at the periphery of some cells
Two small cells with dense round nuclei (erythroid precursors or lymphocytes) in the background
No foamy storage histiocytes or Auer rod bundles clearly identified in this field
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows clusters of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules. Many nuclei are folded, reniform or bilobed, with fine chromatin partially obscured by granules. Rare small nucleated cells are present in the background, and no storage histiocytes are seen in this particular field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation of PML::RARA is required and should be pursued urgently given coagulopathy risk.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi hof and show orderly maturation to myelocytes, rather than sheets of cells with folded bilobed nuclei.
AML with maturation has myeloblasts with fewer granules and occasional single Auer rods, and lacks sheets of heavily granulated bilobed promyelocytes and PML::RARA.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with fine sparse granules and are NSE positive, unlike the strongly MPO-positive hypergranular APL cells.
